title: Crisp Citrus Breeze

diffuser.notes: Add to diffuser with water; run for 30–60 minutes in a well-ventilated room.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist around room, not on skin.

why_it_works: Sweet orange lifts the mood with a sunny, cheerful note; peppermint adds a cool, refreshing twist; lavender softens the blend with a calming floral finish—perfect for warm summer days.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
